appearance.extreme: Both hands are double-thumbed and long-fingered, and they handle small objects the way most people handle a fork.
appearance.obvious: A second thumb sits opposite the first on each hand, shorter but working.
appearance.subtle: There's an extra knuckle on the outside of their palm.

description: A second thumb on each hand, opposite the first. Fiddly work got easier. Gloves got harder.
drawbacks: No glove made for a human fits
name: Second Thumb
